description: This file defines a Hibernate implementation of the VisitDAO interface, providing methods for managing Visit-related data, including retrieval, saving, deleting, and querying Visit objects and their associated types and attributes in the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: HibernateVisitDAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of VisitDAO providing CRUD and query operations for Visit entities.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all VisitType objects, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Searches for VisitTypes matching a fuzzy search phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Saves or updates a VisitType entity.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Saves or updates a Visit entity.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Visits based on various filtering criteria including types, patients, locations, date ranges, and flags for activity and voided status.

methods.name: getVisits (with VisitSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Visits matching complex search criteria encapsulated in VisitSearchCriteria.

methods.name: getNextVisit
methods.description: Fetches the next Visit after a given previous Visit, filtered by visit types and maximum start date.
